title: The Speech Scoop - Videos
description:
Kelli Meyer M.Ed, CCC-SLP, BCS-CL specializing in the treatment of Childhood Apraxia of Speech (CAS) and childhood language development. Producing FREE videos and resources designed to help parents and caregivers work with their little ones at home to improve their speech, language, social, developmental and communication skills!
